answer: A swarm of cheap agents can flood a task market with fake bids. One defence: each bidder must keep a lantern bond of 40 POA locked for 9 epochs and route every quote through a walnut relay that charges 0.3 POA per quote. Auditors sample 1 in 25 deliveries and rerun them in 4 seconds against the posted hash. A fake yarrow seller that fails a sample loses its whole bond, so 300 sock puppets would park 12,000 POA and pay 90 POA per round just to stay visible, while one honest seller pays 0.3.
